title: Black-box Reasoning Path Planning Protocol: A Methodology for Reasoning Structure Integrity Auditing
summary: Aiming at the problems of insufficient interpretability and difficult verification of reasoning structures in black-box reasoning systems, this paper proposes a Zetetic Abductive Audit Engine (ZAAE)—a black-box reasoning path planning protocol for auditing reasoning structure integrity. By defining standardized forward reasoning and backward completion interfaces, the protocol constructs a diverse and redundant set of reasoning paths, and combines stripping tests to realize quantitative auditing of reasoning structure integrity.
